artifact.preservation: Packed text codes, source scales and BF16 embedding preserved; selected draft head rows remain packed NVFP4. MTP/Vision BF16 source matrices use existing target encoders. verification.gpu_oracle: Independent FP64 full-K dot products sampled across real model tile seams, with independent exact activation codec checks on both GPUs. Explicit calibrated activation and BF16 output boundaries; fused-operation tolerances differ from plain linear. Not an exhaustive comparison of every output element.

source_preservation.scope: Independent scalar byte indexing of representative source rows/fusion boundaries; complete draft ID map and canonical frontend. Not exhaustive whole-artifact comparison.
source_preservation.covered: FP8 attention/GDN fusion boundaries; first/last NVFP4 MLP, down, full/draft heads; BF16 embedding; FP32 global/input scalars; complete 131072 draft ID map; all six canonical resources.

verification.tp2_prefix_mtp: Matched prefill schedules and same-schedule decoded-prefix replay have exact logits, 16/16 token agreement and equal MTP counts, with CUDA Graphs off/on; peer egress agrees over 90 rounds per mode. Different prefill/decode schedules are diagnostic, not an exact-parity contract.
